description:
SQUIRREL-TECH: Sincap ruhumuzdaki çeviklikle uzay temalı interaktif oyunlar ve web deneyimleri geliştiriyoruz! Tutkulu ekibimizle yenilikçi mekanikleri ve yaratıcı hikayeleri bir araya getirerek uzay sınırlarını yeniden tanımlıyoruz. Kodla, oyna, keşfet!
​Bu metin tam istediğin gibi oyun odaklı ve takım ruhunu yansıtıyor. Nasıl, içine sindi mi?
summary: ARES-I ODYSSEY is a mission-based game that blends realistic space and aviation disciplines with science fiction, aiming to combine education with entertainment. Centered on the loss of communication with Earth on the final day of the 105-day journey of the spacecraft COLOMBIA-II to Mars, the game offers players the chance to explore space technologies through an immersive narrative. Developed as a single-file project using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—with the assistance of artificial intelligence tools—the game has been published via GitHub and Netlify. Its primary objective is to foster interest in space and aviation among young people while providing an experience that remains grounded in scientific realism.
details: Unlike the superficial, discipline-agnostic space-themed films, series, and games—which often stem from a misinterpretation of how today’s youth engage with technology (focusing on the tools themselves rather than the underlying disciplines like space technology)—this is a realistic, HTML and CSS-based science fiction game developed using publicly available NASA data.
